# PHYS 230 P8: Sensor-Controlled Motors Rubric

**Course**: PHYS/MENG 230  
**Assignment**: P8 — Sensor-Controlled Motors  
**Total Points**: 100

---

| Section | Poor (0–35%) | Good (35–65%) | Excellent (65–100%) |
|---------|--------------|---------------|---------------------|
| **Abstract & Description (10%)** | Missing, vague, or only covers one part. | Mentions sensor/motor; goal stated but key result thin. | Names sensor/motor; system goal and key result clear; explains motivation. |
| **Setup, Characterization & Design (20%)** | No characterization data; no circuit diagrams. | Setup described but PWM widths or Part 2 diagram incomplete/unlabeled. | PWM widths for 0/90/180 stated; labeled Part 2 circuit diagram; control mapping clear. |
| **Implementation & Validation (40%)** | No control code; no validation evidence. | Code present but thin explanation; validation evidence is vague. | Part 2 control code shown and explained; clear evidence (media or scope) of system function. |
| **Results & Stats (20%)** | No quantitative results; stats exercise absent. | Quantification thin; stats exercise attempted but logic/propagation incomplete. | Quantified range/linearity; analyzed motor responsiveness; Stats Exercise 1 complete. |
| **Conclusion (10%)** | Missing or one vague sentence; no results stated. | Summarizes findings but missing reflection or Attributions. | Restates findings; thoughtful reflection on error sources; includes Attributions. |

---

### Stats Exercise Reference

**Exercise 1 (Required)** — Estimate the uncertainty in the Part 1 servo characterization using error propagation (analytical or Monte Carlo). Show measurements, calculations, and the resulting uncertainty in pulse width or angle.
